font.reason: Neutral product/slogan voice; variable font so the design's 500 weight is real (heavier would balloon the 1px outline). Loaded via FaRoot. Estedad, Sahel and Shabnam were trialled; all showed the same join seams, Vazirmatn read cleanest.

comps.translatedSummary: «سریع‌تر» (Faster): outlined word shrinks in from 3.2x, dashed circle and side lines aim at it, then it snaps to solid white with a brief glow.

rtlDecisions.what: Word 'Faster' -> «سریع‌تر», letterSpacing 0.5px -> 0, fs(48), lineHeight 1->1.25, direction rtl, nowrap
rtlDecisions.why: Persian letters join; spacing breaks shaping. Single short word still fits inside the r=88 circle, so circle/line coordinates are unchanged.
A 1px text-stroke on Persian shows seams where joined glyph contours overlap. Now 2px stroke plus a bg-coloured fill copy on top, leaving a clean 1px outer outline; timing and colours unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: Dashed circle rotation sign (t*18) and radial shrink
rtlDecisions.why: Physical spinner-like rotation, not reading order.
Composition is exactly symmetric; both extend in the same window and distance, so mirroring is a no-op.

rtlDecisions.what: Dust scatter, glow, zoom, pop window 0.742-0.762, all seg windows/easings
rtlDecisions.why: Seeded and non-directional; the motion beats must stay identical.

rasterTextHandling: None: pure CSS/SVG, no raster or baked text.
concerns: Dust or circle dashes passing behind the glyph body are hidden by the bg-coloured fill copy (only visible in the first ~3 frames of the 3.2x zoom; negligible).
